judgmentCalls: N1 scope: 'containing type' was read as the exact declaring type from the manifest's qualifiedName (e.g. AdditionalDocumentNamesResolver, not the IAdditionalOpenApiDocumentNameResolver interface it implicitly implements). None of the 6 kept NAV targets' containing types are partial (verified by grep across src/ for a second 'partial class <Name>' declaration), so N1 is always a single location.

N3 interface dispatch: a call through a variable/parameter/mock whose STATIC type is an interface (e.g. IPageFilter, IAdditionalOpenApiDocumentNameResolver) binds to the INTERFACE method symbol, not to a class's implicit implementation, even when the only object that could be behind it at runtime is the target class. This follows the small-fixture precedent (R-04: 'static receiver type is ILoader'). Applied throughout NAV-01 (OpenApiDocumentProvider.cs:71 excluded) and NAV-05 (5 Mock<IPageFilter> Setup/Verify call sites, 1 production filter.OnPageHandlerSelected(...) call, 1 nameof(IPageFilter.OnPageHandlerSelected), 2 XML-doc <see cref> to IPageFilter, and 5 unrelated IPageFilter-implementing declarations all excluded as a DIFFERENT symbol, not merged into NAV-05's static references or dynamic candidates).

N3 Moq expression trees: `mock.Setup(x => x.Method(...))` / `.Verify(...)` lambdas are genuine C# method-call-expression references and are counted as static references when the lambda parameter's static type is the target's own declaring type (PageModelTest.cs:1926, `Mock<PageModel>`), and excluded when it is an interface/base type other than the declaring type (all `Mock<IPageFilter>` sites in PageActionInvokerTest.cs).

N3 method-group/delegate references (no invocation syntax) count as static references when unambiguous: NAV-04's sole reference is `EnsureDataSource` passed as a bare method-group argument to `ConcurrentDictionary.GetOrAdd`, not a call syntactically.

N3 via `using static`: NAV-02's 5 references are unqualified `CreateMissingToken(...)` calls in a different file that has `using static RoutePatternHelpers;`; resolved by confirming the using directive and that no other `CreateMissingToken` overload exists anywhere in the corpus (single global declaration, confirmed by the candidate `rg -n -w` output itself).

N3 via `base.`/unqualified same-class calls to a virtual method: counted as a static reference to the base declaration regardless of possible runtime override dispatch (NAV-05: PageModel.cs:1695 unqualified self-call, DefaultPageApplicationModelProviderTest.cs:1260 explicit `base.OnPageHandlerSelected(context)` inside an unrelated test's override) — this mirrors small-fixture N3/R-06 (explicit-implementation-internal direct call counted).

N3 inheritance without override: NAV-03's 15 within-class calls plus 1 call from a subclass (`NewtonsoftJsonResultExecutorTest : JsonResultExecutorTestBase`) that does not redeclare `GetWrittenBytes` are all counted, since the call resolves (by inherited-member lookup) to the exact target declaration. A same-signature method independently declared as `private` on an UNRELATED class (`JsonResultTest.GetWrittenBytes`, no inheritance relationship) is a different symbol and its 1 call + 1 declaration are excluded.

String-literal/route-path mentions of a target's name (NAV candidate 2, EchoPetWithClassifier's `/Unions/EchoPetWithClassifier` route string in a functional test) were read as neither a static reference nor a reflection/dynamic candidate, since nothing in that call performs a name-based member lookup (it is an HTTP route path resolved by routing middleware, not reflection over the target method) — this determined that candidate had 0 static references and was skipped per R2-2 rule 3.

Core change: introduces TestServer.TestFeatureSwitches, a new centralized helper that overrides 3 Components feature switches (throw-navigation-exception, hot-reload-supported, URL-based QuickGrid nav/sorting) AND updates their already-JIT-cached static fields via reflection (fixing issue #66883, servers racing on stale cached switch values), replacing ad hoc AppContext.SetSwitch/reflection call sites across ~9 test-infrastructure and E2E test files (RedirectionTest.cs alone has 17 one-line call-site swaps) and removing the [Experimental]/ASP0030 QuickGrid AnchorMode/ItemComparer opt-in gate. Two unrelated passkey changes ride along: a new PasskeyRegistrationOptions endpoint/enum value/E2E coverage for registering a brand-new (passwordless) account with a passkey, and a SignInManager.cs doc-comment wording fix (excluded, no code change).
